notes.title: hotfix 2
notes.content:
The second day 1 hotfix!!! The perfectionist in me keeps finding bugs that are too large to ignore so here we are! I really hope this is the last of the hotfixes for today!
changelog:
[list]
[*] fixed some stat tracking to make sure 100% the game is accurate
[*] fixed some floating coin placements in endless mode
[*] made it easier to unlock "Stinky"
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 hotfixes!!!
notes.content:
Ahhh, the good ol' day 1 hotfix... 
here's what changed:
[list]
[*] coins in endless mode now disappear when you collect them
[*] adjusted the requirements for some character unlocks (made it a little easier)
[*] in-game notification icons should now work properly, leading you to the library if there's something to unlock
[*] save data now remembers when you reset resolution back to default
[/list]
